question: What sub-islands and mountains are found in the ninth Kanya division?
premises: The ninth division is Kanya island.
South of it, in the middle of the ocean, there are six sub-islands.
Kanya is adorned by seven chief mountains.
inference: In the ninth Kanya division there are six oceanic sub-islands to the south and seven chief mountains adorning it.
plain_english: In the ninth division, Kanya island, there are six sub-islands in the ocean to the south, and it is adorned by seven chief mountains.
